title: LZ Penalty: An information-theoretic repetition penalty for autoregressive language models
abstract: arXiv:2504.20131v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce the LZ penalty, a penalty specialized for reducing degenerate repetitions in autoregressive language models without loss of capability. The penalty is based on the codelengths in the LZ77 universal lossless compression algorithm. Through the lens of the prediction-compression duality, decoding the LZ penalty has the interpretation of sampling from the residual distribution after removing the information that is highly compressible. We demonstrate the LZ penalty enables state-of-the-art open-source reasoning models to operate with greedy (temperature zero) decoding without loss of capability and without instances of degenerate repetition. Both the industry-standard frequency penalty and repetition penalty are ineffective, incurring degenerate repetition rates of up to 4%.

translated_title: LZ惩罚：一种用于自回归语言模型的信息论重复惩罚
translated_abstract: arXiv:2504.20131v4 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：我们引入了LZ惩罚，这是一种专门用于减少自回归语言模型中退化重复的惩罚方法，且不会损失模型能力。该惩罚基于LZ77通用无损压缩算法中的码长。通过预测-压缩对偶性的视角，解码LZ惩罚可解释为在移除高度可压缩信息后，从残差分布中进行采样。我们证明，LZ惩罚能使最先进的开源推理模型在贪婪（温度为零）解码下运行，既不会损失能力，也不会出现退化重复的实例。相比之下，行业标准的频率惩罚和重复惩罚均无效，会导致高达4%的退化重复率。
tldr: 提出了一种基于LZ77压缩算法码长的信息论重复惩罚方法，使自回归语言模型在贪婪解码下无退化重复且不损失能力。
en_tdlr: We propose an information-theoretic repetition penalty based on LZ77 codelengths, enabling autoregressive language models to decode greedily without degenerate repetition or capability loss.
